procedure: scripts/stage_and_verify_v3.sh <DEST> copies package_items to <DEST>/barely-evolved-transfer/, writes SHA256SUMS, re-hashes at the destination, and runs a representative restore (ffprobe decoded frame count of each SOURCE_MP4 + one RT decode). It refuses a destination on the same device as the source unless --same-device-test is given, and such a test is never durable backup.
r20_pass_requires: a copy at an owner-approved durable off-device destination, verified by stage_and_verify.sh at that destination (and readable from the second Mac)
